summary: cdecl text serializer. Iterates four bytes at a1+268; a byte outside the printable alphanumeric range (below 41, above 122, or in 91..96) is escaped as '[' + two hex digits from the byte_5AF210 lookup + ']', otherwise the byte is copied verbatim. When a2 is non-null it then appends ': ' and copies a 0x40-byte payload from a2, forcing the 64th byte to 0; otherwise it appends a null terminator. Returns the end-of-buffer pointer. Used by DoubleBufferInit (0x0051189C) and TwoStepDelegation (0x005118C1) to serialize a small record.

local_names.a1: source object whose bytes at +268 form the first field being serialized
local_names.a2: optional 0x40-byte payload appended after the escaped field
local_names.i: loop counter over the four source bytes
local_names.v2: uninitialized ecx-derived index in the decompiler output (artifact)
local_names.byte_5AF210: hex-digit lookup used for the two escaped nibbles

operations.description: Loop over i in 0..3 reading the byte at a1+i+268 for escape/verbatim handling.
Escape branch is taken when the byte is below 41, above 122, or strictly between 90 and 97 (i.e. not a printable alphanumeric); otherwise the byte is emitted verbatim.
Writes '[' (91), then two hex digits taken from byte_5AF210 indexed by (v5>>4)&0xF and v5&0xF, then ']' (93).
Copies the printable byte into the output verbatim on the non-escape path.
If a2 is non-null, appends ':' (58) and ' ' (32), copies 0x40 bytes from a2 and forces the 64th byte to 0; otherwise appends a single 0 terminator.
qmemcpy of 0x40 bytes from a2 into the output buffer after the ': ' prefix.
Writes 0 at result[63] to bound the copied payload, or a 0 terminator when a2 is null.
Returns the current buffer pointer, i.e. one past the last byte written.
Consumed by DoubleBufferInit (0x0051189C) and TwoStepDelegation (0x005118C1) as a shared record serialization step.
